landmarks.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: technical source sheet for six registered 2D underwater game landmark layers
Input images: Image 1 is a material, palette, linework, and flat 2D rendering reference only. Do not copy its exact objects, layout, background, or composition.
Primary request: Create one single 16:9 source sheet containing a 2-column by 3-row grid of six registered layer cutouts for one coherent R2 Green Estates landmark: a grand broken municipal glasshouse with elegant oxidized iron ribs and botanical work bays. The glasshouse is a strong readable side-view silhouette; use empty iron framing, damaged opaque glass fragments, work tables, irrigation fixtures, planter racks, and restrained dead or sparse plant remnants.
Scene/backdrop: every cell and every gutter is a perfectly flat, uniform solid #FF00FF chroma-key field. No environment scene.
Style/medium: strongly 2D, strict orthographic side elevation, painted game cutout, restrained material texture matching Image 1, muted olive concrete, aged wood, dark oxidized iron, small desaturated green accents; neutral unlit albedo-like presentation.
Composition/framing: exact 2 columns x 3 rows, reading left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Use a narrow uniform magenta gutter and outer margin, no divider strokes. In every cell keep the same orthographic camera, landmark origin, scale, baseline, center, footprint, and generous padding. The six cells must register perfectly when cropped and stacked at the same origin.
Layer assignment in reading order:
1) L00 rear silhouette: only the faint farthest iron-rib silhouette and rear bays;
2) L01 structural shell: only the main broken frame, pillars, arches, roof ribs and opaque wall fragments;
3) L02 identity core: only the distinctive central conservatory crown, botanical work bays and primary recognizable machinery;
4) L03 detail props: only separate potting benches, empty planter racks, irrigation pipes and one or two small carts;
5) L04 terrain integration: only a few discontinuous edge fragments, dangling broken masonry, isolated brackets and roots; never a floor, shelf, platform, seabed, or continuous lower band;
6) L05 foreground occluder: only sparse near iron ribs, a few cropped leaf silhouettes and one partial frame edge.
Critical registration: each physical component appears in exactly one layer cell; do not duplicate any component between cells; no cell contains the complete landmark; stacking L00 through L05 creates the complete landmark.
Lighting/mood: neutral and unlit. No highlights suggesting a light source, no glow, no cast shadows, no contact shadow.
Constraints: no text, no labels, no numbers, no icons, no UI, no watermark, no characters, no diver, no fish, no bubbles. No perspective, no 3D camera, no isometric view. No fog, haze, caustics, rays, particles, refraction, bloom, vignette, or baked gameplay lighting. R2 is deep open water continuing downward: absolutely no continuous seabed, floor, shelf, platform, bottom frame, or lower boundary. Keep all landmark fragments suspended and open below. Background must remain pure #FF00FF with no gradients, texture, shadows, reflections, or lighting variation. Do not use #FF00FF anywhere in the subject. Crisp antialiased edges and clean separation for chroma removal.
